يحتضنون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِنُونَ (yaḥtaḍinūna) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# يُحْتَضَنُونَ (yuḥtaḍanūna) /juħ.ta.dˤa.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
